content:
name: Machine document synchronization

on:
  pull_request:
  push:
    branches:
      - main

permissions:
  contents: read

concurrency:
  group: document-sync-${{ github.ref }}
  cancel-in-progress: true

jobs:
  verify:
    name: Verify human and machine documents
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
    timeout-minutes: 10
    steps:
      - name: Check out the reviewed revision
        uses: actions/checkout@11bd71901bbe5b1630ceea73d27597364c9af683 # v4.2.2

      - name: Verify generated semantic companions
        shell: bash
        run: python3 scripts/sync-machine-docs.py --check
